purpose: Reanalysis of recovered original records; no new policy selection or experiment

bootstrap.pairing: same physical map/layout and condition across methods

procedural.all_tasks: 32 map clusters, retain all four conditions together within each draw
procedural.common_completions: resample map clusters of condition pairs completed by both methods; retain paired observations together within each map
metrics: Selected minus Diverse completion proportion (percentage points)
procedural.work_definition: per-episode mean_backup_steps times planning_calls; percent reduction = 100*(1-Selected arithmetic mean/Diverse arithmetic mean)

forest.all_tasks: 8 shared layout clusters at each density
forest.common_completions: resample the fixed subset of layout pairs completed by both schedules; report paired n
metrics: paired completion difference in percentage points across all 8 layouts

failure_example.selection: first prescribed cul-de-sac test index; fixed before examining paths
failure_example.times: actual path/summary simulation clock; planning_calls is not flight time
